explication: SpinalHDL is a Scala-based hardware-description library. A hardware author defines Components and signals with the core DSL, optionally composes reusable library blocks, then invokes elaboration to build an internal RTL representation and emit VHDL or Verilog. The repository also provides simulation, formal-verification support, bus protocols, pipelines, peripherals, memories, and SDRAM control. The graph emphasizes this author-to-RTL workflow; several library branches are represented from the tree, while unsampled implementation links remain conservative.
